image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) hanging among other armor pieces. The breastplate features a high-gloss reflective surface, embossed decorative patterns with gold/bronze accents on the lower right, and visible attachment points/straps at the shoulders. To the right, a portion of a helmet or morion with a leather band is visible. The background consists of blurred wooden structures and other metallic armor components.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like cuirass or plastron based on fine details.
To analyze the realism of the reflections and ensure the 'polished' look doesn't exhibit AI-generated smearing or inconsistent lighting.
To verify the sharpness of the metal edges against the background and check for any fusion artifacts with the adjacent helmet or background clutter.
To ensure the spatial relationship between the breastplate, the helmet, and the background rack is physically consistent.

focus_areas: Reflection consistency on curved metal surfaces
Sharpness of embossed details vs. potential AI blur
Boundary separation between overlapping armor pieces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the steel. In AI images, complex reflections on curved surfaces often warp incorrectly or fail to match the surrounding environment. Check if the embossed patterns maintain consistent depth and do not 'melt' into the flat surface. Verify that the text on the helmet band (if legible) is coherent, though this is secondary to the main class.
